description: This PHP file defines an Entity class EnforcePasswordRequest for ORM (Doctrine) mapping. It represents a database table 'ohrm_enforce_password' to manage enforce password reset requests, including fields such as user, request date, reset code, and expiration status.

classes.name: EnforcePasswordRequest
classes.description: Entity class representing an enforce password request for a user, with fields for request date, reset code, and expiration status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the enforce password request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the enforce password request.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User associated with the request.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the User associated with the request.

methods.name: getResetRequestDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the reset request was made.

methods.name: setResetRequestDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the reset request.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the reset request is marked as expired.

methods.name: setExpired
methods.description: Sets the expired status of the request.
